newsitem.title: USA: Vencor sees Q4 charge on nursing homes sales.
newsitem.headline: Vencor sees Q4 charge on nursing homes sales.

text.p: Vencor Inc said Monday it will post an after-tax charge of about $80 million in the fourth quarter on the sale of 34 nursing centers to Lenox Healthcare Inc.
The charge will also reflect the replacement of certain facilities and the previously announced restructuring of its Medisave pharmacy operations, Vencor said.
The transaction is expected to close in 30 to 60 days. Terms were not disclosed.

W. Bruce Lunsford, Vencor chief executive, said in a statement that the nursing centers in the deal posted about $120 million in annual revenues, and that the sale will not have a material impact on next year's earnings.
